messages:
noah: Quick UX report from design review: priority rails feel fiddly in compact editor; hover state is tiny and keyboard reorder isn't announcing target position. Can we address?
maya: Saw that in QA. Hover handle is 14px visually and hitbox is only 16px 0 we should meet 24px min.
oliver: Agree on hitbox. Suggest adding 6px invisible padding and keeping visual size. That avoids layout shifts.
tess: A11y: screen reader only says 'dragging' and not where it lands. We need an aria-live update on drop like: "Rule 'Invoice' moved to position 3 of 7." Also add role="status" on the reorder announcer.
maya: Sim preview nit: when the heatmap compresses the legend wraps and pushes the controls off-canvas. Proposal: collapse legend under a chevron at <720px and allow vertical scrolling in the preview so controls are always reachable.
oliver: Microcopy: current validation tooltip "Rule conflict" -> more actionable: "Priority conflict: two rules match the same input. Reorder or edit conditions to fix." Add inline `Fix` button to jump to offending rule.
tess: Contrast check: the validation pill is 3:1 on dark mode; needs to hit 4.5:1 for text. Will attach failing a11y screenshot.
noah: Timeline: can we get small fixes (handle hitbox, aria-live, legend collapse, copy tweak) in the next sprint? Maya and Oliver to own patches, Tess will verify SR.
maya: I'll open PR for hitbox + collapsed legend CSS today and add unit test asserting handle hit area >=24px.
oliver: I'll do the copy + aria-live announcer change and add a tiny animation on keyboard focus for clarity.
tess: I'll run screen reader pass after PRs merge and post results here.
aria-bot: Reminder: update design spec with new handle hitbox and collapsed legend mock; add accessibility checklist item for reorder announcements. :white_check_mark:
noah: Thanks everyone 0 tagging this for sprint planning. :rocket:
